scope: 20 zones, using exact prepared sources; resident publication is managed separately

policy.source_equality: Exact bytes; only CRLF versus LF normalization allowed. No JSON reformatting or diagram position exception.
policy.source_payloads: Use prepared upload files verbatim. Do not reconstruct or neutralize identity.
policy.browser_ownership: No UI control until explicit exclusive assignment by root.

required_before_changes: Download original entree ZIP via visible UI.
Compare all downloaded source files to upload/entree using verify_wokwi_zip.py and keep the archive backup.
Create a separate saved corrected copy through the visible UI before changing code.
bootstrap.basis: Local git diff for collective/entree shows exactly endpoints.h and four .chip.c files changed. The shared chips/model.h carries the MAX30102 FIFO correction into every generated .chip.c, including zone sensors with other MODEL values. FLOTTE.md confirms regenerated local fleet; this is not proof of website contents.
bootstrap.actual_replace_add: Derive from original downloaded ZIP comparison; replace every mismatch and add every missing expected file. Do not assume diagram.json or any other existing file is identical.
bootstrap.unexpected_files: The final archive must contain no additional source files. If original ZIP has extras, resolve explicitly rather than treating them as inert.
